messages:
maya_sales: Heads upBrightLedger POC in APAC on-prem failing with error 'model_not_available_in_region' for pinned model redwood/gpt-4o-2024-11. They also hit 429s on short stress tests. Need quick unblock options.

tom_infra: Can you paste the error and region?

maya_sales: Error: {
  "code": "model_not_available_in_region",
  "message": "Model not in apac-east onprem bundle"
} Region: apac-east, pinned_version: 2024-11-02

anita_se: APAC onprem bundles lag slightly. We can either: (1) map to compat alias already in bundle, (2) bridge to hosted for short-run, or (3) queue an onprem build (2-3 business days + SOW).

derek_eng: Confirmed: exact pinned artifact missing from apac installer. Alias option: redwood/gpt-4o-compat-v1 (close behavior).

kate_cs: Customer wants no SOW delays. Are aliases acceptable risk-wise?

anita_se: Alias is quick but may exhibit minor output drift. Recommend running a small eval run post-switch.

maya_sales: They also shared gateway logs showing concurrency spikes: [2026-09-22T09:12:01Z] status=429 concurrency=70 limit=50 model=redwood/gpt-4o-2024-11

tom_infra: That's gateway throttling. Ask them to reduce parallel streams to <=40, enable streaming and exponential backoff. I'll open ENG ticket to push the model build to the bundle.

deploy-bot: [notice] apac-onprem-bundle build queued -> ENG-9721 requires runtime approval.

maya_sales: Action items: (1) offer alias + client config snippet, (2) propose hosted bridge if alias rejected, (3) estimate SOW for onprem build and include Dedicated trial pricing option. I'll update once they choose.

kate_cs: Also request customer's KMS vendor for Private install; we support customer-managed KMS/HSM but need vendor details.

maya_sales: Sending now to customer.
